title: "Candidate for Commissioner: Rob Coffman" (Ashley Parkinson, Jun 13, 2022)
notes: Public preview: District 3 commissioner since 2010, seeking a fourth term; says the board balanced 11 budgets with declining revenues and unfunded state mandates; says public safety and road funds need more resources.
